Requirements: R-5, R-6, R-7, R-8
Plan row: TS-15

## Given
A book with stock 1 (marked). A guest session in two tabs.

## Steps
1. Double click Add on the last copy; read GET /api/cart.
2. In tab 2 buy the last copy (set stock 0); in tab 1 click Add; read the page and GET /api/cart.
3. In the quantity box type 0, 1000, 2.5, text, spaces only; click Add each time.

## Then
1. P-doubleclick: the cart after the double click is the one Q4 gives, read through GET /api/cart.
2. P-soldout: the page message and the cart after the sold-out add are those the raised question gives.
3. P-typed: each typed value gets the result Q4 gives, a value typed one key at a time keeps its digits and the field keeps focus.
